definition: In the immanent location profile, a right-summand law representative occupies region r exactly when some existing bearer instantiates it and occupies r. Bearer location is supplied independently. This includes both instance-to-location and location-to-existing-instance support. The weaker forward bridge alone does not license the converse; the populated Controls export its failure. The chosen frame has empty unused related/partOf fields and a designated bearer whole; no geometry, powers, causality, physicality or completeness of this law ontology is claimed.
